title: Coefficient specialization of an ambient tensor isomorphism
statement: Given an ambient tensor comparison for an exact ringed pullback, normalized source and target scalar presentations and a degree-zero coefficient isomorphism, explicitly specialize the ambient comparison at that coefficient and conjugate by the scalar tensor presentations. This gives a natural isomorphism with the displayed component composite.

source.place: Tags 07A4, 0G7E and 06YU; scalar-unit refinement with sites-modules.tex Tag 03EL; parent proof steps 1–6.

proof.text: Whisker the ambient natural isomorphism with the functor fixing its second variable. Follow it by tensoring the coefficient isomorphism, and conjugate by the underlying scalar tensor isomorphisms. Functoriality proves naturality, and evaluation gives the component formula.

proof_origin.place: Explicit formalization of the parent scalar/unit refinement of Tags 07A4 and 0G7E.

theorem ambientSpecialization_hom (M : DerivedCategory (Modules.{u, u, u} R)) :
    (ambientSpecialization f d source target ambient beta).hom.app M =
      f.L.mapDerivedCategory.map (source.underlyingIso.hom.app M) ≫
        f.L.mapDerivedCategory.map ((scalarTensorComparison d.sourceMap).hom.app M) ≫
        ambient.hom.app (M, DerivedCategory.Q.obj (coefficientComplex d.sourceMap)) ≫
        (Functor.uncurry.obj (canonicalDerivedTensor S)).map
          (Prod.mkHom (𝟙 (f.L.mapDerivedCategory.obj M)) (derivedCoefficientIso f d beta).hom) ≫
        (scalarTensorComparison d.targetMap).inv.app (f.L.mapDerivedCategory.obj M) ≫
        target.underlyingIso.inv.app (f.L.mapDerivedCategory.obj M)
